text: Implemented in Python using only the standard library (http.server + sqlite3), no third-party deps
Create post (POST) with JSON body, persisted in sqlite
Read: list posts and get single post by id (GET)
X-API-Key header authentication; requests without/with wrong key rejected (401/403) at least on mutating endpoints
JSON request bodies parsed; invalid JSON / invalid fields rejected with 400
Appropriate REST status codes (201 on create, 200/204 on delete)
